description:
Check a suspicious SMS, WhatsApp, email, or call script for scam red flags.

    Combines regional rule packs with an optional local HuggingFace AI scam model.

    Args:
        message: The exact text of the suspicious message or call script.
        channel: Where it arrived (e.g. 'SMS', 'WhatsApp', 'Email', 'Phone Call').
        region: Regional scam pack to apply ('all', 'global', 'india', or 'us_uk').
name: analyze_scam_message
